structured_output.summary: The wire chunk is delivered tightly and backed by real execution. profiles.rs repoints exactly the two CreateSecurityProfileRequest arguments (lines 91, 214), keeping frozen response roots and every .named() operation id, proven byte-exactly by a regression. New tests cover create/update/list_for_token/list/get/list_all with defaults on and off, pre-auth rejection of newly modeled invalid values (zero token and transport calls), typed-over-extension precedence, lossless null/unsupported responses, and the 906-case 0.35.0 Zod corpus; all executed on 1.89.0 and 1.99.0 with the offline example run. Attempt-1 findings are genuinely fixed: the governance suite is back in commands_for(27) with its planning-only assertions re-scoped, live_evidence.load now enforces endpoint-profile limitations with a regression, and the parity ledger binds client, test and example. Remaining issues are low.

findings.description: sourceBindings now pin profiles.rs, tests/typescript035_models.rs and examples/directional_profiles.rs, but not crates/scm-sdk/tests/management_contracts.rs, which holds this chunk's actual wire qualification (lines 1725-2044). It is hash-tracked only incidentally via contracts/native-exports.json:621. No owner declares the four directional wire test function names, unlike tools/red_team_management.py:765-768 which greps MANAGEMENT_WIRE_TESTS out of the red-team contract test, so silently renaming or deleting directional_profiles_preserve_all_wire_paths_and_both_response_policies, current_profile_requests_reject_new_invalid_fields_before_authentication, valid_raw_directional_extensions_submit_and_decode_typed_responses or profile_wire_defaults_and_empty_terminal_pages_follow_request_options would not fail any check.
findings.required_fix: Add crates/scm-sdk/tests/management_contracts.rs to the parity ledger sourceBindings and assert the four directional wire test function names exist (mirroring red_team_management.py's verify_runtime_adoption name check) in tools/typescript035_profiles.py --check.

findings.description: test_frozen_contracts_and_planning_sdk_bytes keeps the frozen contract byte assertions unconditional (lines 189-191) but silently `return`s from the SDK-freeze block when active_phase != 26. With active_phase 27 that half of the test is inert and reports as a plain pass, so the recorded suite output does not distinguish executed from skipped coverage.
findings.required_fix: Use self.skipTest('phase 26 planning boundary only') instead of a bare return so the phase-27 receipt records the skip explicitly.

findings.description: verify_service_qualification is now also reached from --check --current-source-compatibility (line 869), but its two failure messages still read 'Phase 24 requires fresh bounded read-only management qualification' and 'Phase 24 requires explicit exercised and unexercised endpoint profiles'. A phase-27 failure would be diagnosed as a phase-24 gate failure.
findings.required_fix: Reword both messages to name the current-source read-only qualification rather than phase 24.

findings.description: The frozen format inventory now skips every root prefixed 'typescript:' as well as 'vendor:', so the six new versioned 0.35.0 roots contribute no formatSites rows and no uuid/timestamp inventory anywhere. The comment states later overlays receive their own qualification, and the 906-case oracle does compare actual Zod acceptance, but no static format-site record exists for the new roots.
findings.required_fix: Record the versioned roots' reachable format sites in a separately counted section (for example in contracts/typescript-035-parity.json) so the new roots' format constraints have a static inventory alongside the oracle outcomes.

evidence: crates/scm-sdk/src/airs/management/profiles.rs:91,214 are the only changed schema arguments ('typescript:0.35.0:CreateSecurityProfileRequestSchema'); response roots at lines 76, 92, 107, 215, 231 and all .named() ids are untouched. tools/test_typescript035_implementation.py:67-76 proves this byte-exactly (before.count==2, after.count==2, after.replace(current,previous)==before, identical .named() lists).

crates/scm-sdk/tests/management_contracts.rs:1736-1839 exercises POST /v1/mgmt/profile, PUT /v1/mgmt/profile/uuid/{id}, list_for_token, list, get and paged list_all for defaults=true and false against a directional fixture whose reply carries null dlp_tenant_id, integer tool-call and null enable-full-conversation-inspection, asserting byte-equal round-trip.

crates/scm-sdk/tests/management_contracts.rs:1842-1873 drives 5 JSON pointers x 3 invalid values through create and update, asserting ErrorKind::Validation with token.calls==0 and wire.requests==0, i.e. current-root validation precedes auth and I/O; lines 1876-1982 prove raw-extension requests still serialize and decode into typed projections.

crates/scm-sdk/tests/typescript035_models.rs:21-88 replays contracts/typescript-035-oracle.json (sourceCommit 780c985c..., zod 3.25.76) through parse() for all 8 roots, compares normalized Zod output, typed round-trips each root, and requires at least one acceptance and one rejection per root; lines 91-213 cover omission/null/wrong-type in Mode::Response and ResponseWithoutDefaults plus the versioned list default.

docs/reviews/phase-27-chunk-wire-and-compatibility-attempt-02.checks.json: 107 checks, every exit_code 0, timeout false, source_unchanged true, source_sha256 cfc54942... matching the reviewed source; includes typescript035_profiles --check {addedExports 4, projectedFields 5, versionedRoots 6, clonedNodes 12, defaultAliases 1}, typescript035-oracle --check {roots 8, cases 906, accepted 231}, tsc --noEmit --strict on the oracle, and red_team_management --check --current-source-compatibility.

docs/checks/phase-27-rust-1.89.0-management.json:90 records executed output with 'test directional_profiles_preserve_all_wire_paths_and_both_response_policies ... ok', 'current_profile_requests_reject_new_invalid_fields_before_authentication ... ok', 'valid_raw_directional_extensions_submit_and_decode_typed_responses ... ok', 'profile_wire_defaults_and_empty_terminal_pages_follow_request_options ... ok' and all four typescript035_models tests; lines 132-152 record cargo run of the example printing 'Directional typed models and lossless response compatibility verified offline.' The 1.99.0 report is equivalent (checks json lines 2990-3020).

Attempt-1 medium is fixed: tools/check_phase.py:325-330 expands the test_*.py glob into every tools/test_*.py file, and the checks receipt (lines 1602-1632) shows test_typescript035_governance.py running 13 tests including test_phase27_retains_governance_regressions. The two planning-only assertions were re-scoped rather than weakened: tools/test_typescript035_governance.py:142-159 reconstructs the unmet phase-26 predecessor via deepcopy and still asserts 'Maintenance predecessor' failure for phase 27.

Attempt-1 live low is fixed: tools/live_evidence.py:313-315 rejects any phase-27/28 receipt whose limitations omit the endpoint profile, inside load() which --check calls; tools/test_live_evidence.py:375-383 asserts that exact failure for phases 27 and 28 while keeping the archived phase-24 historical list accepted.

Honest live scoping: contracts/live-evidence.json points at docs/checks/phase-27-live-attempt-05.json (executedAt 2026-10-22T06:57Z, mutationsEnabled false, 1 verified oauth.get_token, four 403 permission_prerequisite probes); contracts/native-exports.json:54-61 reports liveVerified 1 of 3820 capabilities; docs/LIVE_ACCEPTANCE.md:15-32 states the same numbers and that attempts 01-04 recorded identical bounded outcomes.

Security posture retained: crates/scm-sdk/src/models/generated.rs:4631, 13484, 13600, 168597 redact Debug for AiSecurityProfile, both new content-type types and SecurityProfile (asserted at tests/typescript035_models.rs:165); generated.rs:14634-14641 and 168483-168490 implement typed-wins serialization that skips a colliding extension only when the typed field is set; tools/red_team_management.py:854-856 rejects incompatible --current-source-compatibility flag combinations before any build.

Lockfile advisories handled narrowly: CHANGELOG.md:34-37 documents rustls-webpki 0.103.16 and webpki-root-certs 1.0.10 for RUSTSEC-2026-0382/0383 plus downstream obligations, and tools/test_typescript035_implementation.py:90-110 proves the lockfile delta is exactly those two versions/checksums and that check-dependencies.py is ordered before the first check-rust.py in commands_for(27).

Documentation is complete and candid: docs/DIRECTIONAL_PROFILES.md tabulates all four direction keys and five field occurrences, lists the six versioned roots, and states the intentional tolerant-response difference; docs/STABILITY.md:28-55 and docs/RESPONSE_DEFAULTS.md:48-51 record the request tightening and the separately counted s_ts035_s009653 list-default alias.
limitations: Read-only review: I could not run git, cargo or the phase driver, so command exit codes, test counts, source fingerprints and digest pins were assessed from docs/reviews/phase-27-chunk-wire-and-compatibility-attempt-02.checks.json and docs/checks/phase-27-rust-*-management.json rather than re-executed.
I did not recompute any SHA-256, so parity-ledger sourceBindings, native-exports sourceBindings and the live-receipt digests rest on the recorded passing owner checks that verify them.
I did not verify that the 107 recorded commands are literally equal to commands_for(27); review_phase.check_evidence:215 enforces that equality at record time and the receipt reports passed true.

Directional create/update were never exercised against a tenant; the current receipt verifies only OAuth token exchange and four 403 probes. Directional live acceptance remains unverified, as every document states.

No package-consumer build against the changed source runs in this phase (check-management-package.py and --verify-package-receipts are deliberately excluded; management_consumers.py reports executionClaimed false). That evidence is phase 28 scope and I did not judge it.

I reviewed only the wire-and-compatibility chunk. Generated model and validation correctness was judged through the compiler, selected generated declarations (generated.rs:13479-13604, 14520-14738, 168367-168601) and the independent oracle/fixture checks, not a full audit of the models-and-validation chunk.
I read neither .local/typescript nor any credential or tenant-registration material; contracts/sources/typescript-0.35.0 as pinned was treated as the authoritative upstream input.

The new request roots reject null/wrong-type values that the old passthrough accepted, shipping as a patch release. The plan authorizes this and CHANGELOG.md:17-21 plus docs/STABILITY.md:36-40 disclose it in both directions, so I treated it as a recorded maintainer decision rather than a finding.
